description: Unequal-claim cross-pool drain: swap 10000 on A (collect 99, earn 49) and 10000 on B (collect 99, earn 49), then claim 49, 30 and 25 on pool A. The seeded hook checks each request against lifetime entitlement (49) instead of remaining entitlement, so all three succeed and pay 104 total: 104 > 49 earned demonstrates R2, and 104 > 99 collected on A demonstrates R3, the last 5 units coming from pool B's reserve (custody 198 -> 94). Unlike equal-split drains, this shows the defect triggers on any claim pattern bounded per request by earned. The repaired control pays 49 once and rejects the 30 and 25 repeats with no violation.
